text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Five parts of a headshot prompt, plus one negative line
Each part settles one thing the image model would otherwise decide for you

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 1

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Identity lock
Controls: whether the face in the output is the face in your photo
Without it: nothing asks the model to keep your face

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 2

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Framing
Controls: a 1:1 square, head and shoulders, camera at eye level
Without it: a tall or wide image you have to crop into the round frame

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 3

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Attire
Controls: what you wear, in plain colours with no logos
Without it: the model picks clothes that may not match your work

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 4

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Background
Controls: a plain or softly blurred backdrop behind your head
Without it: clutter that competes with your face at thumbnail size

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 5

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Lighting
Controls: soft front light, natural skin texture, true colour
Without it: hard shadows or skin smoothed until it looks plastic

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: NEGATIVE LINE
Do not: change my face, slim or age me, smooth my skin, whiten my teeth, change my eye colour,
or add jewellery, text, a logo or a watermark
